name: Frenk
subtitle: Remember people thoughtfully
promotionalText: Names, context, follow-ups, birthdays, and gentle check-in reminders—kept private and close at hand.
description:
Frenk helps you remember the people you meet and the context that makes a future conversation easier.

Add someone in seconds with a name, Instagram username, phone number, where you met, and a short note. Add more detail only when it is useful.

Today keeps time-sensitive things in order: overdue follow-ups, upcoming birthdays, people you meant to check in with, and the newest people in your circle.

Use Frenk to:
• Save people quickly after meeting them
• Log texts, calls, coffee, meals, classes, events, and other interactions
• Add follow-ups with clear due dates
• See time since your last interaction
• Use relationship-based reminder intervals you control
• Search by name, contact detail, note, major, residence, or tag
• Export your information as JSON or CSV
• Delete your account and owned data from the app

Frenk has no streaks, social scores, public profiles, ads, or social-network scraping. Your records are private to your account.
